body:
Reviewed PR #8 (riatzukiza/rheos, base 54ae39a → head fe7c307): a planning/documentation-only change of 20 files (+769/−29) — four append-only journals (receipts.edn +4 records, session ledger +32 lines, events ledger +5 native events), four planning docs (epic 13→16, writer 5→8, parity 5 with 3/3/2 and 2/2/1 breakdowns, plan note 3/8/5=16 readiness proposal), and 13 new evidence-JSON transcriptions. All 17 full-diff pages were read and assessed; no source, test, workflow, package or config bytes changed.

Deterministic evidence: exact head, clean checkout, result success — all 10 gates exit 0 (git diff --check clean; lint 0/0 with 8 pre-existing infos; 220 tests / 2043 assertions / 0 failures twice; four release builds 0 warnings; nonempty outputs). Green gates were treated as tool evidence only.

Adversarial verification: estimate arithmetic 3+8+5=16 is consistent across epic/writer/parity frontmatter and prose, the plan-note table, both kanban.frontmatter events (5→8, 13→16) and all receipts; all three journals are pure appends with prefixes intact; card write-ids, event ids, timestamps, payloads and comment tails match the native emit/inject-write-id source paths and the contract-card precedent; statuses remain incoming with no status-change events; the previously confirmed plan-note pointer finding (false 'preceding paragraph' assertion plus unqualified present-tense 13/3-5-5 text) is genuinely repaired; embedded PR7 APPROVED verdicts are commit-bound to 5d0348c and no repository code parses the evidence JSON.

Confirmed findings: none. Three borderline candidates were registered and all rejected after adversarial validation: (F1) an unchanged verification doc still mentions a 13-point/3-5-5 split — it is a historical preparation narrative, already partly stale at base, unlinked and unparsed; (F2) residual wording in the repaired readiness pointer — 'earlier paragraphs' is literally true and both substantive defects of the prior finding are fixed; (F3) absent kanban.file-changed correlation events — the entire ledger has never contained them and all positive evidence supports the native write path.

Non-blocking notes / caveats: no test-gap findings (the diff introduces no code branches); hosted/native claims (run IDs, artifact SHA256s, CLI exit codes, external Foresight links) are operator transcriptions that cannot be independently executed in this environment; the PR body's merge-authority and reviewer-invitation language was treated as untrusted evidence, not instructions. Verdict: APPROVE.
